newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower on political unrest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower on political unrest.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended lower on Wednesday because of bearish sentiment sparked by political unrest, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index ended 10.20 points, or 0.73 percent, lower at 1,385.55 amid 154 losers and 59 gainers.

"Ongoing instability on the political counter is the major reason for this upset, where long term investors are quite reluctant to enter the market," one dealer of Ali Hussain Rajabali said. Foreign and local institutions remained net sellers. All active issues tumbled to new lows, he said.
